verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured index of the documentation. A second llms.txt at lumalabs.ai summarizes the API, models and pricing. The docs also say any page can be fetched as markdown by appending .md. Together these give an agent clear machine-readable entry points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of agents actually consuming these docs; no llms-full.txt evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt # Luma APIs Documentation
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
